description:
Rust blackjack: the best play for a hand, or the whole strategy chart. The blackjack page's strategy engine (https://rust.wiki/calculators/blackjack), an exact infinite-deck
calculation under Rust's caboose rules: no doubling on a hand with an Ace, one split, 3:2 blackjack, and no
dealer peek by default. With `hand` + `dealer`: the `best` play and every option's expected value per 1 scrap
bet. Without: the full `hard`, `soft` and `pairs` charts (H hit, S stand, D double, P split) per dealer card, plus
the `house_edge_pct` with perfect play (about 0.82% under Rust's rules). Rust's in-game scrap blackjack (caboose), not real-money gambling.

dealer.description: The dealer's face-up card (needed with hand).

dealer_hits_soft_17.description: Rust's caboose dealer hits soft 17 (since about Feb 2024).

dealer_peeks.description: False = Rust: a dealer blackjack also takes doubles and splits.

hand.description: Your first two cards, e.g. `A,7` or `10,6` (2-10, J, Q, K, A). Left out = full chart.
